Verbatim NASA PSI files (CC0-1.0, per investigation metadata licenseIdentifier), copied byte-for-byte
from data/raw/samples/. Each file's sha256 equals its Source record in data/manifests/<investigation>.jsonl
(the checks assert this), so every parsed value is traceable to the NASA asset and locator.

ntrs_*.json: NTRS API responses saved on 2026-11-14 (public NASA metadata, re-indented, not edited):
a two-record search for "flame extinguishment experiment" and the citation record 20150023456
(FLEX NASA/TP-2015-216046). They pin the response shape the NTRS client parses.
